result.summary: The page is largely well-formed; the partially visible carousel item at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected scroll behaviors. One genuine visual defect remains: the pizza card's discount badge displays '-0%', which is a meaningless placeholder/value error.

issues.description: The badge on the second 'Popular right now' card shows '-0%', a meaningless discount value (zero percent off) that looks like broken placeholder data.
issues.suggestion: Either remove the badge when the discount is 0% or populate it with a real discount value (e.g. '-10%'); add a guard so badges never render for zero-value promotions.
